backup_location.description: Local directory to back up and associated options

path.description: Root directory path to scan for changes and back up

max_filesize.description: Largest file (in bytes) to back up. Files larger than this are skipped. Set 0 for unlimited.

skip_patterns.description: List of file/directory patterns (glob-style) to exclude from backup

skip_xattrs.description: List of extended attribute names (e.g., 'user.cache') to ignore on files

scan_interval.description: Seconds between scans for file changes (minimum recommended: 60)

auto_upload.description: If true, automatically upload changes as soon as they are detected

max_upload_rate.description: Maximum bytes per second to upload. Set 0 for unlimited (no throttling)

address.description: Hostname or IP address of the BoxBackup store server

port.description: Port number for the backup protocol (10025 is standard)

certificate_file.description: Path to the server's SSL/TLS certificate (PEM format) for verification

store_public_key_file.description: Path to the public key (PEM) of the store — required for encrypted backups

account_number.description: Account identifier assigned by the BoxBackup store admin (must match server)

pid_file.description: Path to write the daemon PID file

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout

encrypted.description: Enable client-side encryption before upload (requires store public key and client private key)

warning_age.description: If last backup is older than this many days, issue a warning

post_backup_command.description: Optional shell command to run after each successful backup (e.g., send notification)
